title:
An image reference in parsed Markdown: `![alt](path)`. A title may be specified after the path (in the parens).
The alt markup appears as child nodes of this node.

Note that documentation rendering supports image sizes using a `@` suffix to the #destination (src):
```md
![alt](path/file.png@200x150)
```
If a size suffix is used, the at sign and `x` are required, but either width or height may be omitted; both `@500x`
(width only) and `@x500` (height only) are valid. _There must be no whitespace in the destination._

@see MarkdownNode
@see MarkdownLink
name: MarkdownImage
